title: maint.event.v1{kind=backup_restore_started}
description: Phase 8 §8.3 — emitted by maint.backup.v1 when an operator-driven `restore` request begins (consumer of `maint.event.v1{kind=restore}`). Notification only; the operator already received their `maint.ack.v1` for the originating `restore` envelope (acceptance gate). Mirrored as a row in `maint_audit_log` for right-to-restore traceability.

target.description: Resolved DSN-or-DB-name the dump was restored into (synthesized ephemeral target when the operator did not pass `destination_conn`).

destination_conn.description: Operator-supplied destination DSN (empty when defaulted to ephemeral target).

ephemeral.description: True iff the consumer synthesized an ephemeral target (`negelir_restore_<dump_date>`); false iff it restored into operator-supplied `destination_conn`.

reason.description: Operator narration mirrored from the originating `restore` envelope.
